planner_finish.summary:
SOLVED libero_goal task 5 seed 2 ("push the plate to the front of the stove") in a single episode with zero resets: top-level terminated == true at step 52.

Approach: the task is a push predicate, so no grasp/Pi0 was used — the closed gripper (+1) served as a blade. Localized the striped ceramic plate and the flat stove purely from agentview_high RGB + SAM3 ("the red and white striped plate", score 0.87-0.90) and re-segmented it after every shove.

Sequence: (1) shoved the plate +y from below its center: (0.062 -> 0.166) via a table-level move_pose push at z~0.915 with step_clip 0.004; predicate did not fire. (2) Noticed the plate had drifted to x=+0.017 (outside the front-of-stove x-band), so repositioned to its +x side and pushed -x, landing it at (-0.042, 0.171) — still no termination. (3) Discovered back-projection over the white stove slab is degenerate (constant bogus z ~1.08-1.13 from invalid specular depth), so the region could not be probed from the stove surface; instead read the matched seed-0 reference (goal_task_t5_s0.json / recipe, same "push X to the front of the stove" structure) which validated the goal zone at ~[-0.02, 0.22]. (4) Dropped the blade behind the plate at (-0.042, 0.096, 0.917) and drove a slow +y push toward y=0.163 — In(plate, front_of_stove_region) fired after ~15 steps with eef at (-0.0395, 0.1014, 0.9188).

Audit and recipe written to the episode output dir.
